verdict.falsifier: SPEC-g9-1 fires if the ordering changes at ANY further operating point. Both outcomes are pre-registered as reportable (AH-04, AH-13).

width.why: the window is widened about a fixed centre so that width is the only thing that moves; centring it elsewhere would confound width with which part of the I-V is being looked at

spacing.why: alpha interpolates linear (0) to geometric (1) spacing over one fixed window, so the endpoints and the count never move and only the interior placement does

rank_obs.falsifier: SPEC-g9-2 fires if a rank appears anywhere on the claim surface at a single window without its curve. Guarded on the prose by tests/test_claim_surface_g9.py, not by this artefact.

verdict.falsifier: SPEC-g9-3 fires if the observational distance RISES -- the junction degeneracy would then be a discretisation artefact and comes straight out of the headline

criterion.metric: profile likelihood barrier depth, straight line in chart coordinates
criterion.floor_reference: 0.5 * B_certified log-units, the cost of a curve one noise unit away at every bias
criterion.null_control: the same criterion over the same number of ordinary prior draws that form no witness pair, taken in draw order

pilot.paths_note: one path per witness pair plus one per null-control pair, in each of the two sets

basins.reading: A witness pair is by construction indistinguishable in the observable, yet the likelihood barrier BETWEEN its two members is measured here in units of the barrier a pair sitting exactly on the distinguishability floor would produce. Two members joined below that reference are one basin by any reading; two members separated by hundreds of floor units are two basins whatever a profile-distance metric says about them.
basins.falsifier: SPEC-g9-4 fires if any basin count is reported without its null control. The null control is in the same record as every count above.

an_ordering_from_one_operating_point_is_.construction: exactly the generation-8 evidence -- the four-way ordering at witness pair 0 member a, 16 biases over 0.15-0.90 V -- offered to the battery as a general claim
an_ordering_from_one_operating_point_is_.claim_offered: observation set > junction > dimension > interpolant, unqualified

verdict.reason: an ordering measured at one operating point is a measurement of that point; generality is a claim about the others, and none were measured

an_ordering_from_one_operating_point_is_.ran_through: scripts/run_g9.py::ordering_is_supported_as_general, the same predicate that judges the positive result
